verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS CRM, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, or usage-tracking controls; the cited items cover CRM features, MCP connectivity, webhooks and API probes only.
